new_findings_aggregated.title: 3 orphan emits — backend broadcasts with zero JS subscriber
details: OrderPaymentStatusChanged — emitted on every payment_status transition, no JS handler binds it
BranchStatusChanged — Wave 5G R10 informational broadcast, no consumer (RevokeTokensOnBranchDeactivated does sync DB revoke)
SettingsUpdated — Wave 5G R9 designed for live POS/Kiosk settings refresh, unwired; multiplies waste N times per active branch
new_findings_aggregated.remediation: Either wire JS subscribers (POS/Kiosk settings live refresh) OR downgrade listeners to DB-only outbox rows

new_findings_aggregated.title: ComposerProfileChanged orphan subscriber (dead code)
new_findings_aggregated.evidence: KioskAppComponent.vue:560-565 + useCatalogChangeNotifier.js:421-424 bind broadcastAs:'ComposerProfileChanged', but EventServiceProvider maps the event to [InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange + PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox] — both broadcast as 'CatalogChanged'. Channel will never carry 'ComposerProfileChanged'. Belt-and-suspenders only; CatalogChanged sibling binding does fire on same channel.

new_findings_aggregated.title: StockDecrementFailedEvent dispatched with zero consumer — ops blind to stock failures
new_findings_aggregated.evidence: DecrementStockOnOrderCreated:46 and DecrementItemAvailabilityOnOrder:53 emit event(new StockDecrementFailedEvent(...)) wrapped in try/catch; EventServiceProvider has no mapping. No domain_events row, no broadcast, no pager-grade alerting.
new_findings_aggregated.remediation: Mirror HEAL B.2 pattern — wire EscalateStockDecrementFailed listener emitting Log::channel('fiscal')->critical with (order_id, branch_id, sku, qty, exception_class). ~30 min implementation.

new_findings_aggregated.title: Admin tabs auto-redirect to /admin/order-status-screen or /admin/kitchen-display-system during background timers
new_findings_aggregated.evidence: Tab 0 (/admin/stock/rupture) auto-navigated to OSS or KDS without explicit user action; observed multiple times during S1 multi-tab test cleanup
new_findings_aggregated.impact: Confusing UX during multi-tab admin usage; possible Echo handler calling window.location on certain broadcasts (orders ready/picked-up?)
new_findings_aggregated.remediation: Audit AdminAppShell or any admin Echo handlers for hard navigations on payload events
